info.title: KAgent Provisioning Token API
info.description: Management of provisioning tokens used by Kentik Agents to register without user credentials: creation, retrieval, revocation, and listing of the agents registered with a token.

get.description: Returns a list of all provisioning tokens in the account.

post.description: Creates a new provisioning token based on configuration in the request and returns it, including its secret value.

get.summary: Get provisioning token configuration and status.
get.description: Returns configuration, usage and revocation status of the provisioning token with the specified value.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Value of the provisioning token to be retrieved.

get.summary: List agents registered with a provisioning token.
get.description: Returns the IDs of all agents that have registered with the provisioning token with the specified value.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Value of the provisioning token to list agents for.

post.description: Revokes the provisioning token with the specified value. Agents already registered with the token are not affected, but the token can no longer be used for new registrations.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Value of the provisioning token to be revoked.

revokedBy.description: Email of the user revoking the token.
revokedBy.title: who is revoking the token

Response message for creating a provisioning token.

v202401GetProvisioningTokenResponse.description:

Response message for getting a provisioning token.

agents.description: IDs of agents registered with the token.

v202401ListProvisioningTokensResponse.description:
ListProvisioningTokensResponse
Response message for listing provisioning tokens.

token.description: Value of the provisioning token (UUID). Treat this value as a credential.

maxUsageCount.description: Maximum number of agents that can register with this token (default 1).
maxUsageCount.title: Maximum number of agents that can use this token. Defaults to 1

currentUsageCount.description: Number of agents already registered with this token.

expiresAt.description: Time at which the token expires (default one hour after creation).

allowedPrivateCidrs.description: Private IP CIDR blocks allowed to use this token. When empty, any private IP is allowed.
allowedPrivateCidrs.title: Array of private IP CIDR blocks allowed to use this token. When not set any IP is allowed

allowedPublicCidrs.description: Public IP CIDR blocks allowed to use this token. When empty, any public IP is allowed.
allowedPublicCidrs.title: Array of public IP CIDR blocks allowed to use this token. When not set any IP is allowed

clusterId.description: ID of the cluster to assign agents registered with this token to.

requiresApproval.description: Indication whether agents registered with this token are placed on the pending approval list instead of being approved automatically (default false).

config.description: Additional configuration to apply to agents registered with this token.

revoked.description: Revocation details. Set only if the token has been revoked.

createdBy.description: Email of the user who created the token.

v202401ProvisioningToken.description:
ProvisioningToken
ProvisioningToken represents a provisioning token for automated agent registration.

siteId.description: ID of the site to assign to agents registered with this token.

RevokeProvisioningTokenResponse
Response message for revoking a provisioning token.

revokedBy.description: Email of the user who revoked the token.
revokedBy.title: who revoked the token

revokedAt.description: Time at which the token was revoked.
